Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my name on this recording, but I can answer your questions about the accident.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the accident happened?
A: It was an intersection in Pasadena, Texas. I was turning left across the lanes when another vehicle hit my car on
the driver's side.
Q: Which direction were you traveling before the turn?
A: I was heading straight through the intersection and then started to turn left onto the side street.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?
A: I saw headlights, but I thought there was more time. I started my turn and that was when the collision happened.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, I was.
Q: How are you feeling now?
A: Not great. I have a bad headache, I feel foggy, and bright lights bother my eyes. The doctor said I have a
concussion and I need to rest for a while.
Q: Did you lose consciousness at any point?
A: I don't think I passed out completely, but everything went blurry for a few seconds and I was confused when the
paramedics arrived.
Q: Have you been seen by a physician since the accident?
A: Yes, I went to the emergency room that evening and I've had a follow-up appointment since then.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm still having trouble concentrating at work, and I'd like my vehicle damage reviewed as soon as
possible.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
